items.title: Koszul complexes of sequences related by an invertible matrix are isomorphic
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that replacing a sequence by the sequence obtained from it by an invertible matrix of coefficients does not change the isomorphism class of the Koszul complex. The proof writes the new sequence as the image of the old one under the linear map given by the transpose of the matrix, observes that this linear map is an isomorphism of free modules of the same rank, and appeals to the functoriality of the Koszul complex, which turns an isomorphism of the underlying modules into an isomorphism of the complexes.
